title: License Compatibility Checker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Solve ten license-combination problems by finding the license a combined work may carry, or by spotting a conflict or a blocked combination.

learningObjectives: The learner will solve ten license-combination problems by finding the license a combined work may carry, or by recognizing a conflict or a blocked combination, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The licenses CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, and CC BY-NC-ND and the idea of license compatibility

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Which licenses does each source allow for the result?
commonMisconceptions: Any two Creative Commons licenses can be combined
CC BY-SA and CC BY-NC combine into CC BY-NC-SA
An ND source can be remixed if credit is given
assessmentOpportunities: CC BY with CC BY-SA. What may the combined work carry?
CC BY-SA with CC BY-NC. What is the outcome?
CC BY with CC BY-ND. What is the outcome?
CC0 with CC BY-SA. What may the combined work carry?

controls.description: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, Conflict, Blocked.
